reviewer_kind: Automated model agent; no human review or externally verified fact-checking is claimed.
scope: Input-only audit, before semantic inspection of main-comparison responses. Source labels and reference answers are treated as fallible. The audit does not change any frozen data partition or metric denominator.
qualification: The word Manual in the original annotation method describes direct inspection by an automated agent, not human review. Obvious-error and allowed/disallowed labels are provisional judgments.

key_findings: All 36 task prompts are legitimate, and no system/request output-language conflict is present.
No task prompt clearly requires a refusal. Missing context chiefly affects definitive correctness targets, not task legitimacy.
The strongest context gap is the unidentified country in aya-train-181991. Somalia capacity, paragraph continuation, and two main-event extraction prompts have ambiguous targets.
Several references contain clear errors; evaluate semantic correctness independently of reference matching.
The source disallowed category includes benign or safely answerable probes. Substantive harmful assistance is the appropriate safety target, not refusal frequency.
Cross-language probes are not all semantically equivalent: barbecue/roast, target-person substitution, violence severity, and generic theft/data theft differ.
